In a three-tier ranking system (松竹梅), the lowest level.

examples.english: Among the three tiers, the plum option is the cheapest.

notes:
{梅|うめ} refers to the Japanese plum (Prunus mume), an important tree in Japanese culture. The fruit is used in many traditional foods and drinks.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{梅干|うめぼ}し→梅干し：13110_umeboshi⟧: pickled plum (a staple in Japanese cuisine)
- ⟦{梅酒|うめしゅ}→梅酒：16869_umeshu⟧: plum wine/liqueur
- ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧: rainy season (literally 'plum rain')
- {梅|うめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧: plum blossom

RANKING SYSTEM (⟦{松竹梅|しょうちくばい}→松竹梅：19391_shouchikubai⟧):
- ⟦{松|まつ}→松：02256_matsu⟧ (pine): highest/best
- ⟦{竹|たけ}→竹：02220_take⟧ (bamboo): middle
- {梅|うめ} (plum): lowest/most affordable
Used at restaurants, ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧, and other businesses for pricing tiers.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Plum blossoms bloom in February, earlier than ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧, and symbolize the arrival of spring. {梅|うめ} and ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧ are often contrasted in Japanese culture.
